items.title: Noah Cook Interview, 1960-08-30
items.q: I saw Villa Kersan. The greatest minister man ever after the Negro race, after the Civil War.

ctx.x: Well, I'd like to just have the words. It sounds like a good song to me. It is. I got to write it.

I'll write it and give it to you. I'll write it and send it to you. I'll do that. And if you make that sing out, let them know. But I'll write it. I can't bring it like now. No. But I had written that twice. I had it in my desk there, but I lost it. And I had these here humming around on it. And they say my daughter, my granddaughter, she was singing for the record. And I tried to get her to sing it. And she said it's too old fashioned. But it's not old fashioned. It's a song that is sung by Villa Kersan. The…
